Remark
[Basic properties of real analytic functions] ↗ def:real-analytic-function 1. ch4:4.6.2-rem-1\group Power Series Methods

Analytic functions are $C^\infty $ and \[ f_\alpha =\frac{D^\alpha f(x_0)}{\alpha !},\qquad f(x)=\sum _\alpha \frac{D^\alpha f(x_0)}{\alpha !}(x-x_0)^\alpha . \]
